summary.zh: 11 点全部投入惩戒系：招架、更短的审判冷却和额外暴击，20 级拿到命令圣印。
summary.en: All eleven points in Retribution: parry, a shorter Judgement cooldown, and extra critical strike, then Seal of Command at 20.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，用神圣打击与审判单刷任务
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, solo questing with Holy Strike and Judgement

pros.zh: 偏斜提供 5% 招架：单刷时少挨伤害，招架还会加快你的下一次挥击。
pros.en: Deflection adds 5% parry: less damage taken solo, and a parry speeds up your next swing.

pros.zh: 强化审判让审判冷却缩短 2 秒，圣印伤害的触发频率明显提高。
pros.en: Improved Judgement takes 2 seconds off Judgement, so your seal damage lands noticeably more often.

pros.zh: 定罪投入 3 点，提供 3% 近战暴击，并开启第三层。
pros.en: Three points in Conviction add 3% melee critical strike and open the third row.

pros.zh: 20 级的命令圣印让你的攻击有几率造成相当于 70% 武器伤害的额外神圣伤害。
pros.en: Seal of Command at 20 gives your swings a chance to deal extra Holy damage equal to 70% of weapon damage.

pros.zh: 20 级主要组队？把偏斜的点数移到祈福，瞬发法术与圣印的法力消耗降低 10%。
pros.en: Grouping at 20? Move the Deflection points into Benediction for 10% cheaper instant spells and seals.

pros.zh: 主要面对亡灵或恶魔？把定罪的 2 点移到神圣导能，可以更频繁地使用 20 级解锁的奉献与驱邪术。
pros.en: Facing Undead or Demons? Two points from Conviction into Holy Conduit pay for more frequent Consecration and Exorcism, both of which unlock at 20.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
